v209.tp_admission: Requires CUDA DFLASH, page-sized-one, DP=PP=attnCP=attnDCP=1, live prompt+verify+mixed extents, distinct request slots, valid native graph keys and mixed padding no larger than separate. Rejects CP graphs, PDMux, ragged verification, MLP TP gather and two-batch overlap. Rank MIN/MAX agreement covers graph sizes and a seven-word cohort signature containing the sharding verdict in its hash. The proposal is consumed after agreement. A decline takes existing standalone verify and prompt. Static and runtime SP FC/RMSNorm eligibility separately use TP Gloo MIN.
v209.tail: Static load_batch carries mixed_verify_logits_indices and mixed_verify_sharded_logits. FULL reuses a private copy of the raw batch; BREAKABLE uses its static batch. MuseSpark Omni supplies text embeddings and calls the Muse causal model. runs_sp tests configured SP and EXTEND, independent of a stale captured Python flag. On eligible rows the eager tail packs target taps, calls the released draft FC/RMSNorm per owner, then gathers the projected features. Projection needs at least 128 rows per TP rank. Projection is optional on smaller or guarded shapes.
v209.logits: LogitsMetadata preserves both fields. Selected SP hidden-row gather requires fewer selected rows than local hidden rows; otherwise native gather and pruning applies. Local head return also requires the existing aligned, contiguous FP32 CUDA softcap path, local vocab width and supported topology. Hooks on model/processor, global hooks and instance forward replacements disable V209's authorization. The full-vocab fallback remains available. set_mixed_verify_rows retains one end row per prompt and every verification row.
v209.settlement: Native trim carries context and KV flags; settlement gathers prompt vocabulary, reduces tail token/score pairs using deferred_argmax(first_nan=True), samples prompt once and passes predicted tail IDs to _accept_block. Mixed rows cannot invoke prompt-only paired KV projection (kv_helper=None and mixed marker). Prompt append writes prompt slots; tail append receives dense [B,W] slots plus actual commit_lens. Both fused-materialization and per-layer fallback call a prefix-valid writer, never an unconditional tail flatten-store in this branch.
